rules: No Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Headings (Chivo) must have tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and be bold/black.
Overlines/Labels (like 'Days done') must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) using IBM Plex Mono.
Max heading size text-4xl for page titles, text-2xl for widget/habit titles.
Use typography to create tension; contrast massive sharp headers with neat monospaced metadata.

colors.theme: Light mode heavily preferred for this physical journal feel.
guidelines: Do NOT use generic SaaS blue. Use Terracotta (primary) and Pale Moss/Sage (secondary).
Never use pure black; use Obsidian/Charcoal (0 0% 10%) for borders and text.
Background is a warm sand/bone white, creating a paper-like feel.

rules: Use 2px or 3px solid borders (border-2 border-foreground) on all cards, inputs, and buttons.
Hard Offset Shadows: Instead of soft drop shadows, use solid color block shadows. Add a custom utility or inline class like `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(26,26,26,1)]`.
NO glassmorphism on cards, only solid flat colors.
Square corners everywhere (`rounded-none`). No soft radii.

component_name.strategy: Shadcn components completely stripped of their default soft 'Vercel' look.
customizations: Cards: Remove default shadow and radius. Add `border-2 border-foreground shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#1a1a1a] bg-card`.
Inputs/Textareas: `border-2 border-foreground rounded-none shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#1a1a1a] focus:shadow-none focus:translate-x-[2px] focus:translate-y-[2px] transition-transform`.
Checkboxes (7-day): Make them large and chunky. `w-8 h-8 border-2 border-foreground`. When checked: `bg-primary text-white`.
Buttons: Pill shape is BANNED here. Use sharp rectangles with hard shadows.
Badges (Shared/Private): `border-2 border-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-mono text-xs shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#1a1a1a]`.

grids.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards) mixed with Asymmetry
rules: Habits List: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` with generous gap `gap-6` or `gap-8`.
Habit Detail Stats: Use a dense Bento grid for 'Last 7 days', 'Days done', and 'Current streak'.
Do not leave jagged bottoms. Use `h-full` on flex/grid children.

structure: Sidebar (Left): Fixed width (w-64), solid background, thick border-r-2 border-foreground.
Top Nav: Sticky height (h-16), solid background (no transparent), thick border-b-2 border-foreground.
Main Content: Generous spacing `p-8 lg:p-12`. Max-width constrained for readability.
alignment: Left-align text heavy content (Habit descriptions, Comments).

tactile_interactions: Buttons on hover: slight -translate-y-1, increase shadow offset to 6px.
Buttons on active/click: translate-x-[4px] translate-y-[4px] shadow-none (presses the button into the shadow).
Staggered entrance animations for the habit list.
accessibility: Ensure focus-visible states have high contrast 2px outline and offset.

rules: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Buttons must explicitly state text color on hover (e.g., `hover:text-white`).
Do not rely solely on color to indicate the 'Shared' vs 'Private' state; use distinct icon or explicit label.

auth_banner.description: Soft pastel cream organic abstraction. Use as the left/right split background on the Sign Up/Sign In pages to contrast the harsh neobrutalist forms.

empty_state.description: Dark green organic shape. Use as a small graphic (e.g., rounded-full and bordered) when a user has no habits yet or the community feed is empty.

3d_libraries.decision: Not required. A simple habit tracking app benefits from clarity and fast tactile interactions over 3D visual noise. Keep it 2D.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Create standard React `.js` or `.jsx` files. You have .js files not .tsx files.
You are building a React frontend using Tailwind and Shadcn.
CRITICAL: Apply the Tactile Neo-Brutalist theme exactly as defined (thick borders, hard offset shadows, square corners).
Inject the defined CSS variables directly into index.css.
Do not add extra features like habit categories, complex graphs, or nested replies. Stick exactly to the requested functionality.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with duotone or bold weight to match the thick borders.
Ensure 'My Habits' and 'Community' navigation links exist in BOTH the sidebar and top header (for mobile responsiveness).
Habit list items must visually distinguish 'Shared' vs 'Private' prominently (e.g., a colored badge with sharp borders).
For the 7-day checkboxes in Habit Detail, display the dates (YYYY-MM-DD) clearly above or next to the chunky checkboxes.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications (`yarn add sonner` or via shadcn).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using the hard offset shadows for this app).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles (For this app: sharp rectangular buttons with hard offset shadows and press animations).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but heavily customize them to fit the Neo-Brutalist theme.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
